# iru_blueprint (List Resource)

Lists existing `iru_blueprint` objects for `terraform query`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every blueprint.
list "iru_blueprint" "all" {
  provider         = iru
  include_resource = true
}

# Only the blueprint named "Core".
list "iru_blueprint" "core" {
  provider = iru
  config {
    name = "Core"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only list blueprints with exactly this name.
